description: This file declares the 'Request' class used for JSON-RPC WebSocket communication within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace. It includes methods for creating requests, retrieving IDs, and converting requests to string, along with internal ID generation logic.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC request message for WebSocket communication, with methods to create requests, get their ID, and serialize to string.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC request with specified method and parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the request.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the request to a string.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for the request.
